newsitem.title: POLAND: HANDLOWY SEES POLISH BANK BOS 96 NET UP 46.5 PCT. [CORRECTED 14:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HANDLOWY SEES POLISH BANK BOS 96 NET UP 46.5 PCT. [CORRECTED 14:40 GMT]

text.p: Polish bank Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA's (BOS) net profit is likely to grow to 46.6 million zlotys this year and 53.5 million in 1997, up from 31.8 million in 1995, Bank Handlowy brokerage said in its report.

It said in the report dated October 11, BOS whose public offering starts later this month, should lift its interest revenues (corrects from revenues from securities) to 111.7 million zlotys this year and to 127.3 million zlotys next year, up from last year's 94.5 million.
On Tuesday BOS President Jozef Koziol predicted that his bank would earn 54 million zlotys this year.
BOS plans to enter the Warsaw bourse's main market in January. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
